meta.name: content-planner
meta.description: GSC-driven content calendar. Pulls real Search Console data, finds the highest click-potential opportunities (striking-distance queries at positions 5-20, unanswered query intent, related-keyword expansions), and produces a dated, prioritized content calendar — ready to hand to /content-writer. Use when the user asks "plan my content", "what should I write next", "content calendar", "content plan", "content roadmap", "editorial calendar", "what topics will rank", "find quick-win SEO topics", "click-potential analysis", or "schedule my SEO content".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据搜索数据生成优先内容日历
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用搜索数据决定下一篇写什么能获得最多点击。
copy.tagline_en: Generate a prioritized content calendar from search data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decide what to write next based on search data for maximum clicks.

howto.what: 装上后,它会用你 Search Console 近90天的真实数据,找出点击潜力最高的机会(如排名5-20的高展示查询、未被回答的意图),生成带日期和优先级的内容日历(JSON+摘要),可交给 /content-writer。
howto.when: 当你说“规划我的内容”“内容日历”“接下来写什么”等请求时触发;若尚未连接 Google Search Console,它会先引导你完成 OAuth 再继续。

say.text: 根据 GSC 数据,规划一个三个月的内容日历。
哪些关键词现在排在第5到20位,值得优先优化?
say.note: 它会找出点击潜力高的接近排名查询。

say.text: 帮我排一下下周要写的内容,先做 P0。
say.note: 日历会先安排最高优先级的主题。

howto.what_en: Uses your last-90-day Google Search Console data to find high-click-potential topics (positions 5-20, unanswered intent), and outputs a dated, prioritized content calendar (JSON + summary) for /content-writer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan content, request a content calendar, or ask what to write next. Requires a connected Google Search Console; otherwise it walks you through OAuth first.

say_en.text: Plan a 3-month content calendar from GSC data.
say_en.note: It pulls Search Console data and builds a dated, prioritized list.

say_en.text: Which keywords at positions 5-20 are worth optimizing first?
say_en.note: It finds striking-distance queries with high click potential.

say_en.text: Schedule next week's content, P0 first.
say_en.note: Pushes the highest-priority topics to the top of the calendar.
